irene: Quick preflight for 23:30 UTC cutover. This touches API (deprecation header), runtime (kv/cache tweak), console (affinity fallback) and router (header->cookie migration). Need pins and any hard blockers now.
dan: Ack. Runtime pinned to v3.12.0. KV/cache change live only in canary. No hotpatches during the window.
mike: Console ack. We'll keep legacy X-SESSION header and COOKIE_OLD fallback for 2 hours post-rollout. Enabling verbose mismatch logs for 30m.
irene: Router plan: start header-to-cookie at 1% -> 10% (15m) -> 25% (30m) -> hold 30m. Rollback criteria: session loss >0.6%, auth 401s >0.4%, p99 latency +120ms.
dan: I'll add smoke tests to deploy: /health + 3 prompt gens (short/med/long). Abort on token errors or session drop >0.3%.
deploybot: deploy scheduled by @irene for change-window. target: runtime:v3.12.0, api:v2.14.1. canary: router.header-cookie-migrate -> 1% at t+2m.
oncall-bot: oncall rotation: dan (23:00-07:00 UTC). Pager rules active.
mike: Console will emit synthetic sessions during canary and post a CSV every 10m with match rates. Alert if mismatch >6/min.
dan: Adding grafana panels: router.header.mismatch, console.session.drop, runtime.kv.evictions. Alert thresholds in release notes.
irene: Rollback quick commands for copy-paste:
```
/deploy rollback --service runtime --to v3.11.9 --reason "header-cookie regressions"
/deploy toggle router.header-cookie-migrate off --env prod
```
